name: VolunteerRelatedProjects - Three Suggestions
description: The suggestion row at the tail of a project detail page, below the sign-up CTA. Three other open projects rendered as the same cards the /volunteer grid uses, carrying three different date shapes so the row shows how a range, a start-only, and an end-only read at card width. Which projects land here is relatedProjects decision — adjacent in editor order, wrapping — not this component. The empty branch renders nothing at all: no heading, no section.
